findings.title: Table widget renders empty data when feature flag is enabled
findings.body: When the organization has the use-table-widget-visualization feature, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and tableData containing data: [] and empty meta, instead of converting result.data/result.meta and the widget fields into tabular data. Any dashboard table widget for such an organization will therefore show an empty table with no columns, losing the previously displayed query results.

findings.title: Error events can be paired with the wrong error IDs when nodestore results are missing
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids but then zips error_ids with events.values() from nodestore.backend.get_multi. get_multi is keyed by node_id and may omit missing events, so if any event is absent the remaining values shift and are paired with the wrong event_id. This can attach the wrong title, message, and timestamp to an error in the Seer summary request, or drop/misattribute errors silently.

findings.title: Error timestamps are compared against replay segment timestamps in different units
findings.body: gen_request_data compares error_events timestamps, which come from the stored event payload as epoch seconds, directly against replay segment event timestamps, which are rrweb timestamps in epoch milliseconds. Because milliseconds are roughly 1000x larger, all errors will be yielded before the first breadcrumb regardless of their actual chronological position, so the AI summary receives error context in the wrong order.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: The new HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES list (is_segment, project_id, received) is applied only in the branch taken when searchQuery is non-empty. When searchQuery is empty, sortedAndFilteredAttributes returns sortAttributes(attributes) unchanged, so the supposedly hidden internal attributes remain visible in the default attributes list and only disappear after the user types a search query.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion validation for age/timestamp misses age=0
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age check self.initial_data.get('age')/get('timestamp') for truthiness. A report containing timestamp plus age=0 (a valid freshly-generated report age) will pass both validators even though the serializer intends to reject reports that mix the Working Draft timestamp field with the Editor's Draft age field, weakening the spec validation added in this change.
